positioning: own the arrival, own the margin
thesis: Your guests already arrive by boat. Navier makes that arrival the best part of the stay — and a margin line you own.
the_deal: Minor brings 109 coastal-relevant properties and a captive guest base; Navier brings the silent foiling fleet proven in the live Maldives network. Together we turn every resort transfer into a branded, zero-emission signature.

your_world.label: Where you are today
your_world.text: You operate 100+ coastal and island resorts where the last mile is water — and guests take the resort's boat.

your_world.label: What you're up against
your_world.text: Diesel speedboats and outsourced launches leak margin, fumes, and weather risk on the arrival guests remember first.

your_world.label: Where Navier fits
your_world.text: A branded electric hydrofoil fleet you control end-to-end — gateway pickups, inter-resort hops, and curated excursions.

your_world.label: Why now
your_world.text: Maldives is live at scale; Phuket, Bali, and Palm Jumeirah floors are grounded — captive economics, not contested mobility.

_provenance_note: Operator-developer archetype: Captive · Calm · Clean · Continuity. KPI-free slide 2; WIDTH metrics on slide 3.
